# Notes on the Agent Era — Jimmy Li

> Essays and notes on AI agents, memory and writing. Every essay is versioned and broken down into citable claims (C1, C2…). Please cite the post URL and version when quoting.

## Essays
- [Why a Shenzhen Team Can Test Hundreds of Ideas a Year](https://0xff-96.github.io/AgentBlog/posts/shenzhen-hardware.html): v3, 2026-11-06. A paper-style, interactive reading of bunnie Huang's The Hardware Hacker. Claims: C1 the round trip to suppliers takes hours in Shenzhen, not weeks; C2 reusing market parts, reference designs and housings lets a small team test hundreds of ideas a year instead of a few dozen, and proximity roughly doubles that; C3 speed settles technical and production questions, only users settle demand. Table 3 (Appendix A) cites a published source for each price and lead time and marks the rest as assumptions.
- [Agents Need Episodic Memory, Not Bigger Context](https://0xff-96.github.io/AgentBlog/posts/agent-memory.html): v3, 2026-11-02. Retrieving past episodes beats scaling the context window for long tasks. Placeholder draft.
